summary: Sandbach United fought back brilliantly against Cheadle Nomads in an entertaining encounter, with substitutes making a real impact to turn the game around, but they couldn't hold on as the hosts grabbed a dramatic equaliser in the dying seconds to secure a 3-3 draw. Foley was among the goals with a brace, while the introduction of Fowles and others shifted the momentum in Sandbach's favour during the second half, though it ultimately proved bittersweet with that last-gasp leveller.
